**What was wrong:** `ReconciliationWorker.run` counted each payment row that matched no order. A bank retry with the same payment id is a second row, so it was counted twice. The fix counts distinct payment ids instead (`src/orders-api/reconciliation_worker.py:11`).

- `tests/test_orders_api.py`: added `test_a_retried_payment_counts_once`, which has two rows with the same unmatched id and expects 1.
